tools.name: swap_quote
tools.description: Compare ranked routes across providers for a swap, without building or spending anything. Ranked by net value after gas and platform fee, not raw output, with ONE unit price for the output token across every route, so a friendlier price feed can never put a route that delivers fewer tokens on top.
